svg.title: Step-response identification of the heater
svg.desc: On the 12 percent estimation step the temperature changes by 2.398 degrees Celsius, so the gain is 0.1999 degrees per percent. The logarithm of the remaining gap falls on a straight line of slope minus one fifth, so the time constant is 5 seconds and the delay 1 second; the detectable onset comes later, at 1.4 seconds. On a separate 10 percent step the frozen model predicts the temperature within 0.0013 degrees RMS.
svg.text: Reading the heater's numbers from a step
Control Studio recordings · estimation step 75 → 87 % at 5 s, validation step 75 → 85 % · numbers answer the predictions
Fitted model: K 0.1999, L 1 s, τ 5 s
Detectable onset 1.4 s after the step; delay 1.0 s
63.2 % at 6.0 s after the step: τ = 6 − 1 = 5 s
Straight line: −1 at 6 s, −2 at 11 s after the step;
slope −1/5 per second, so τ = 5 s
Frozen model on the new step: RMS error 0.0013 °C
